course.title: GIS and Remote Sensing
course.department: Department of Urban and Regional Planning

content.value: Assume that the distance between two points was measured to be 120 mm on a vertical photograph and 300 mm on a map. If the surveying ground distance between the same two points is 6000 m, what will be the photo scale and map scale and the scale reciprocals of the photograph and the map? Provide your judgments on the photo scale and map scale to describe the level of detailing of the photographs and their respective application.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
